notes: Owned by C (ShorthandEdge). Source of truth for first-round agreed lex / policy.
Base mix is EN + ZH + JA (starting set, not a hard ceiling across A–E; B also ranks Romance/Germanic/Greek).
When conjunctions or adverbs show up, inserting English often helps readability.
Prefer shorter alphabet / cognate spellings when they align with meaning.
Concrete lex mappings live under conventions[]; policy-only items have kind=policy.
ℹ️ (information) is C family=emoji (EMOJI_SPEC / emoji-information); not E etymon.
Furniture EN table → short desk/table lexeme; canonical to=机; allowed_to includes JA/ZH and Romance/Germanic/Greek desk equivalents (mesa/Tisch/tavolo/tafel/τραπέζι). SQL/tech contexts keep table.
Ambiguity gate (C): conjunction shortenings marked ambiguity_sensitive skip when short form already collides in-text, or prefer_precision=True (CLI --prefer-precision).
lex metrics (required): token = B TesseraTalk estimate_tokens; bit = E MorphoZip utf8_bits (default) or closed_inventory_bits when inventory applies. Both views narrow registration candidates.
E MorphoZip closed-POS mappings are registered here as apply_layer=E (metrics + inventory) for the shared ledger; rewrite engine ownership stays on E. C apply_ledger_lex only applies apply_layer=C.

Skipped ambiguous (not registered as emit): in/on; fr as canonical (alias only); bare ES o; bare el/er/sie as outputs; cuz (prefer bc/∴ family); DE du as emit (FR du false friend — alias-only); we/us/our not core inventory slots.
Deferred-at-100 batch restored after zero-bit prune: brb/AFAIK/whereas plus clear C slang with utf8 bit shrink (no zero-bit re-adds).

family=abbrev (C-only): contractions (c-ill / I'll-family via apply_en_contractions; ledger_apply=false), chat acronyms (c-asap…), latin shorts (e.g./etc./vs/i.e.). Polarity: after C don't/can't, E may fold don't→! / can't→!can on C,E pipeline.

family=emoji (C-only): ML aliases → pivot (default EN; JA ok) → emoji via EMOJI_SPEC; ledger rows record pivot/pivot_lang; ledger_apply=true (two-step apply). Dual metrics; utf8 must shrink on sample. Short-form priority: math/symbol first when meaning is clear, else emoji — prefer existing inventory over inventing new math or emoji peers (check→✓ not ✅; star→★ not ⭐; cross→✕ not ❌). information→ℹ️ is C; FYI phrase is DEFAULT_MAP-first. Bare fire/idea/eyes/… utf8-flat forms may live in DEFAULT_MAP runtime extras. Cross-lang cheapest: select_cheapest_form / policy-cross-lang-cheapest (token then utf8).

family=symbol (C-only): open math/symbol shortenings not in E closed POS (≠ ∞ ± % ° ⇒ ⇔ ∝ √ × ÷ …). Prefer over emoji when meaning is clear (policy-short-form-priority). Skip E-owned ~/≒/= /≧/≦/∴/bc/∀. Dual metrics; utf8 must shrink. Cross-lang cheapest via select_cheapest_form.

family=ever (C): 5W1H concessive multiword → -ever (no matter how→however, what→whatever, which→whichever, where→wherever, when→whenever, who→whoever). Meaning gate on however: contrastive「しかし」 is out of scope — only listed multiword concessive from[]. ambiguity_sensitive on ever-however (collision / prefer_precision). whyever skipped (awkward). Cognate aliases (egal wie / no importa… / n'importe…) only when select_cheapest_form prefers the -ever and utf8 shrinks. ASAP remains preferred over 尽快 (c-asap).
breakdown (内訳): compact shared labels — POS 代/示/助/前/副/接/助動/冠/比/絵/記/名/動/関代/…; else 連/熟/俗/文/頭/略/↓T/↓B/時/複. Long EN tags (collocation/acronym/relative/…) rewrite to these.

Formal/legal + connective tranche (finite): therein→∈it, thereto→∴to, henceforth→∴→, notwithstanding→雖 (in spite of は prep 側), insofar-as→insofar, provided that→if, instead of→vs (in lieu of / rather than / pursuant to は prep cycle2), namely→viz, hence/thus→∴, albeit→tho, the foregoing→supra, aforementioned→said, vice versa→⇄, T&C, etal, given that→bc. hereof/thereby/hereto/herewith skipped (sense clash with thereof/∴/thereto/therewith). cycle11 filled spaced deferred (as of/latin/loc-time). Prep/adverb thickening is a separate tranche.

family=relative (E 関係代名詞/関代): which→that (EN-internal; tok 2→1; post-nominal/non-restrictive gate; not interrogative which?/pied-pipe prep which); whom→who; Romance/DE long forms (lequel/welcher*/el que…)→que shared pivot. Do NOT emit bare q. deixis that→eso and complementizer/relative-that skip gate unchanged. Skip: whose (no clear short), lo que (what-clause 揺らぎ), relative where/donde/où/wo (ever-wherever/wo 揺らぎ), bare qui rewrite of who.

ever_family.note: family=ever C lex + meaning_gate. Policy row is a registry pointer only (demoted from bespoke policy).

spatial.description: Spatial / size pair shorthand (↑↓, under, above, 左右, …).

conventions.rationale: throughout → 通（select_cheapest; ML partout/全程）。prep2非膨張の有限登録
toward(s) → →（助詞に/へと同スロット；select_cheapest で → ≻ 向/vers）
conventions.cross_layer_note: → は助詞 に/へ の canonical。方向 toward を同記号へ寄せる

conventions.rationale: hereinafter → ∴↓（dual metrics win；referred to as は ∴=）
herein → ∈（助詞でスロットと記号共有・文書内）
conventions.cross_layer_note: ∈ は助詞で も canonical。herein は文書内の法務短形

conventions.rationale: therewith → ∴w/（w/ 単体は with；damit 別名；select_cheapest）
whereby → ∴by（意味保持の短形が dual metrics 勝利）
regarding/concerning → re:（について→re: と整合）
as follows → ↓（列挙導入）。the following は翌日等と曖昧のため見送り
inter alia → i.a.（ラテン短形；utf8+token 縮）
besides → 他（+は助詞も衝突回避）
during → 中（amongと記号共有・時空）
bare instead → 代；instead of は既存フレーズ vs（衝突回避）
according to → 依（select_cheapest; àは冠詞揺らぎ）
owing to/due to → 因（∵=whereasと分離）
in spite of → 雖（despiteと共有）
by means of → 手段（via見送り継続）
in accordance with/pursuant to → 準（依=according toと分離）
up to → ≦（量の上限；compare-leと共有可）
in light of/in view of → 鑑
in lieu of/in place of → 代（insteadと共有）
in case of → 場合（ifは過圧縮）
regardless/irrespective of → 不問（雖=despiteと分離）
aside from/apart from/other than → 他（besidesと共有）
following → 次（prep用法優先；as followsはC↓）
by virtue of → 力（依=according toと分離）
by way of → 経（bare viaは見送り；courtesyと同スロット可）
on account of/by reason of → 因（owing/dueと共有）
in regard to → re:（with regard toはC WRT）
on top of → 且（上=above；追加・重畳）
at the expense of → 犠牲
in the event of → 場合（in case ofと共有；ifは過圧縮）
in the middle/midst of → 最中（中=among/duringと分離）
for lack of/for want of → 欠
in excess of → 超（≧=up to/at leastと分離）
in contrast to/with → 対比（vsは反対・置換用）
in the course of → 過程
over the course of → 通（throughoutと共有）
in the face of → 面前（対=againstと分離）
courtesy of/by courtesy of → 経（by way ofと共有）
therein → ∈it（∈there は utf8 増；in it は token 非勝利）。∈ 単体は herein
conventions.cross_layer_note: ∈there は legacy expand のみ。toward の → とは別

conventions.rationale: thereto → ∴to（to that）。→ は toward なので意味ゲートで除外
henceforth → ∴→（hereafter と同義・同表層。別 id）
conventions.cross_layer_note: expand(∴→) は hereafter。同義の損失展開

conventions.rationale: notwithstanding → 雖。tho/but は前置用法を落とす。in spite of は prep-in-spite-of、despite は prep-despite が既に 雖
範囲の接続句 → insofar。裸の to the extent（of $N）は意味が違うので見送り
pursuant to / in accordance with → per（C）。E prep-in-accordance-with→準 と併存。under は spatial 下へ連鎖するため除外。per は for-each と衝突し得る
条件の法務句 → if。subject to は governed-by と揺れるので見送り。if は曖昧ゲート
instead of → vs。in lieu of は prep-in-lieu-of→代、rather than / as opposed to は prep-as-opposed-to→vs
namely → viz（viz. より token 同・utf8 安。i.e. は言い換えで別）
結果接続 → ∴（so より token 安；C の therefore→so とは別経路）。thereby は by-that-means で ∴by=whereby と衝突するため見送り
conventions.cross_layer_note: C conj-therefore は therefore/consequently/as a result→so。hence/thus/now therefore はより長い句を先に ∴ へ（therefore 断片の so 化を避ける）。E _SUBS も ∴

conventions.rationale: 譲歩 although/albeit/even though → tho。対照 however の意味ゲートは触らない
the foregoing → supra。above は token/utf8 同点だが spatial above→上 に連鎖するので除外
aforementioned/aforesaid → said（法務限定詞）。動詞 said と衝突し得る
vice versa → ⇄（vv より token 安；select_cheapest）
and others / et al. → etal（et al より token+utf8 安。FR et→& は alias-only で et を食わない）
given that / inasmuch as → bc（理由。insofar は範囲なので混ぜない）
null and void → void（法務の二重語。意味は void に残る）
for the purpose(s) of → 目的
at the mercy of → 弄（左右は spatial と衝突）
ahead of / in advance of → 先（beforehand/preceding と同終端）
adjacent to → 隣（next to=傍 と分離）
in defiance of → 反（against=対 と分離）
in the presence of → 在（面前=in the face of）
at the price of → 代価（犠牲=expense/cost）
in parallel|tandem with → ∥（meanwhile と同終端）
in line|step with → 沿（along と同終端）
depending on|upon → 依（according to と同終端）
as well as → +（in addition と同終端）
let alone / much less / not to mention → 況
faced|confronted with / up against → 直面
for the time being / for now → 暫
from time to time / now and then / by chance → 偶
on purpose / by design → 故意
at present / at the moment → 今
by and large|on the whole → 概
in any case|event|at any rate → 何れ
in the long run → 長期
on the other hand → 他方
to some|a certain extent → 或程
little by little|bit by bit → 徐
again and again|over and over → 繰
in the short run → 短期
to a large extent → 大程
in succession|back to back → 連続
by no means|in no way → 決して
for the duration of → 期間
so to speak|as it were → 言わば
off and on|on and off → 断続
more often than not → 大抵
at a glance|at first glance|sight → 一見
as of → 起（起算；@は prep-at）
of late → 近頃（近は nearby）
hitherto → 従来（未は as yet）
thus far|to date → 今迄（so far utf8非勝）
by and by → 稍後（徐は little-by-little）
mutatis mutandis → 準変（mmは mm 単位衝突）
ipso facto → 当然（if 衝突回避）
de facto → d.f.（事実上 utf8非勝；df 曖昧）
in situ → 現場（is 衝突回避）
ad hoc → adhoc（臨時 utf8非勝；a.h. は冠詞 strip で欠落）
関係代名詞 which→that（EN内; tok 2→1）。bare q は出さない。指示 that は deixis-eso、補文 that は対象外。
関係代名詞 whom→who（目的格; tok同・utf8勝）。疑問 who? はゲート外のまま。
Romance/DE 関係詞長形→que（shared pivot; select_cheapest）。lo que・bare q・whose・関係where は見送り。
